## Change

Describe the problem and the new behavior. Link the issue if applicable.

## Checks and evidence

List the commands you ran and their results. Include the macOS version and architecture for native changes.
State any native path or device that you did not exercise.
For performance changes, include the workload, baseline, changed result, and memory impact.

## Review

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and any AI-generated code.
- [ ] I kept this change focused and preserved unrelated work.
- [ ] I included relevant checks and removed private data from attachments.
- [ ] I updated user documentation and dependency notices when applicable.

New contributors are welcome. If you need help, open a draft and describe the specific uncertainty.
